name: tech-prediction-methods-development-20261020
notes: ADR-0273 ten-method study, DEVELOPMENT document on the next-session label: scores the 2020 fold only to pick one knob per method (Ridge alpha, Lasso alpha, boosting iterations) by the ADR-0272 rule (argmax of the mean over horizons 5 and 20 of the pooled 2020 R2oos, per target). Baselines mean and the frozen ADR-0272 lagged model. No trade rule, P&L or edge claim.

calendar.notes: Pins the chronological calendar the folds copy.

surface.notes: The same immutable artifact the v6 replay and ADR-0272 pinned.

precision_edges.notes: The same immutable artifact the v6 replay and ADR-0272 pinned.

correlation_edges.notes: The same immutable artifact the v6 replay and ADR-0272 pinned.

surface_term.notes: 30/90-DTE surfaces with term slope and OI aggregates from the pinned Theta members.

positioning.notes: Vendor EOD Greeks summed with open interest per symbol-day.

panel_surface.notes: Pair differences, legs, prior-only Z/sd and changes of the surface panel: 30-DTE surface at the t close (our Black-76 IVs from Theta NBBO).

panel_returns.notes: Pair differences, legs, prior-only Z/sd and changes of the returns panel: adjusted-close log returns through the t close; the 20-session leg sd is realized vol.
